description.value: Pho 68 is a Vietnamese noodle house on Richmond's busy Number 3 Road corridor, serving cuisine built around fresh herbs, fish sauce, and the balance of five fundamental flavors. It is part of a small Lower Mainland chain with additional locations in Burnaby and Surrey. Dine-in with table reservations and online ordering are both available.

address.value: Unit 150 - 4651 Road No. 3, Richmond, BC V6X 2C4

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 4m; rack at 17m; rack at 49m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the OSM name, address (Unit 150 - 4651 Road No.3, Richmond, BC V6X 2C4), and Vietnamese cuisine category. The website's 'SEE MENU & ORDER' button and online ordering interface confirm takeout availability. No bike parking, water refill, washroom, or cyclist-specific amenity information appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; (778) 985-8860 found on website for the Richmond location and has been used as the listing phone.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible Vietnamese restaurant with a confirmed active website and address. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a full meal.

wow_evidence: small Lower Mainland chain with additional locations in Burnaby and Surrey

price.label: Cheap eats
price.signal: Explicitly called 'noodle house'; pho is inherently budget cuisine
